title: Grammar Sparsity Sets How Transformers Learn Random Languages
abstract: arXiv:2611.29692v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study language acquisition by transformers trained on the Random Language Model: a synthetic hierarchical grammar with random production rules, whose sparsity is controlled by a single parameter and whose conditional entropies are known exactly. On depth-two grammars, we find that sparsity sets both the order and the speed of learning. Dense grammars are learnt one level at a time: a token is predicted from its sibling after $t\propto V$ steps and from the full context only after $t\propto V^{3}$, so the two stages are separated by a plateau that widens with $V$. Sparse grammars are learnt all at once, at $t\propto\sqrt V$, with a smaller exponent than even the first stage of a dense one. The exponents $1$ and $1/2$ already appear at depth one, where we derive them for a linear model trained with Adam.

translated_title: 语法稀疏性决定Transformer学习随机语言的方式
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在随机语言模型上训练的Transformer的语言习得过程：随机语言模型是一种合成的分层语法，具有随机的产生式规则，其稀疏性由单一参数控制，且其条件熵可以被精确计算。在深度为二的语法上，我们发现稀疏性决定了学习的顺序和速度。稠密语法的 learned 一次一层：token 在 $t\propto V$ 步后可以从其兄弟节点预测，而只有在 $t\propto V^{3}$ 步后才能从完整上下文中预测，因此这两个学习阶段被一个随 $V$ 增大而变宽的平台期分隔开来。稀疏语法则是一次性全部学习，在 $t\propto\sqrt V$ 步内完成，其标度指数甚至比稠密语法的第一阶段还要小。指数 $1$ 和 $1/2$ 在深度为一的情形中就已经出现，我们对使用 Adam 训练的线性模型推导出了这两个指数。
tldr: 语法稀疏性同时决定了Transformer学习随机语言的顺序和速度——稠密语法分层学习且经历随词表大小变宽的平台期（$t\propto V$ 到 $t\propto V^3$），而稀疏语法则一次性快速习得（$t\propto\sqrt V$）。
en_tdlr: Grammar sparsity sets both the order and speed of how transformers learn random languages: dense grammars are learned level-by-level with plateaus widening with vocabulary size (t∝V to t∝V³), while sparse grammars are learned all at once at t∝√V.
